name: DSFR for Drupal - Picker - Examples
description: Provides examples to add custom icons and pictograms with code.
project_description: Submodule of DSFR for Drupal - Picker. A worked, code-only example showing how a module can extend the icon/pictogram picker: it registers a custom icon group and a custom pictogram group through the picker's provider hooks, removes a built-in group through the alter hooks, injects a stylesheet into the DSFR icons library, and resolves a custom pictogram identifier to an on-disk SVG path. It installs no fields, content types or configuration; it is intended to be read and copied, not run in production.
